name: Front Cover & Balancer
description: Timing cover, front crank seal, harmonic balancer/pulley and the torque-to-yield balancer bolt procedure.

components.name: Front (timing) cover
components.description: Cast-aluminum front cover enclosing the timing chain and oil pump. On Gen V it carries the cam position sensor and the VVT actuator solenoid, and seals to the oil pan front rail.
components.location: Front face of the block, behind the balancer and water pump.

factory.name: GM Gen V front cover (wet sump)
factory.notes: Dry-sump (Corvette) covers differ around the pump.

hardware.notes: Summit and Michigan Motorsports both list front cover bolts at 18 ft-lb.

hardware.item: Oil pan to front cover bolt

installNotes: Replace the cover gasket and front seal; RTV at the block/pan T-joints only.
Use a centering tool / balancer to center the seal before tightening the cover.
Cover must be flush with the pan rail before the pan is installed.

components.name: Front crankshaft (damper) seal
components.description: Lip seal in the front cover that seals on the balancer hub. Included in the GM-style cam install kit.
components.location: Front cover, around the crank snout.

factory.name: GM Gen V crankshaft damper seal

installNotes: Drive in square with a seal installer; light oil on the lip; never install dry onto the balancer hub.
inspection: Check for oil sling around the balancer.

sources.title: Michigan Motorsports: Gen V cam install kit for wet sump LT engines

images.title: LME Gen V VVT-delete timing cover kit (front cover shape)

modelRef.features: Steel-cased PTFE/rubber lip seal pressed into the cover

components.name: Harmonic balancer (crank damper) & pulley
components.description: Elastomer damper with the accessory-belt and supercharger-belt grooves. It is press-fit on the crank snout and clamped by a torque-to-yield bolt. Road-race engines often switch to an SFI-rated fluid/elastomer race damper (ATI Super Damper).
components.location: Front of the crankshaft, ahead of the front cover; bottom center of the accessory drive.

factory.name: GM LT4 balancer (anodized aluminum hub, iron ring); LT1 iron balancer
factory.notes: Gen V truck balancers (12684590 / 12680364) are different spacing - do not use on Camaro.

raceOptions.name: ATI Super Damper 918856 (2016+ Camaro LT1 / LT4 wet sump, 7.48 in 6-rib, with A/C pulley; SC pulley sold separately)

installNotes: Lube the seal surface and snout lightly; press the balancer on with an installer tool or the OLD bolt to full seat (do not hammer).
Remove the seating bolt, install a NEW TTY bolt and torque per engine.front-cover-and-balancer.balancer-bolt.
Many race builders pin the balancer (dowel) on boosted engines.
inspection: Check elastomer for walking/cracking; check index mark alignment; SFI tags if required by rules.

components.name: Harmonic balancer bolt (TTY)
components.description: Torque-to-yield crank bolt that clamps the balancer. GM 11547372 is the wet-sump Gen V bolt and must be replaced every time the balancer is removed. Two GM bolt designs exist (separate rotating washer vs solid flanged head) with different final angles.
components.location: Center of the balancer, threading into the crank snout.

factory.name: GM wet-sump Gen V balancer bolt

raceOptions.name: ARP balancer bolt (where offered for Gen V)
raceOptions.notes: Follow ARP torque with Ultra-Torque. Part number not verified here.

hardware.item: Balancer seating (installation) pass - using OLD bolt or installer
hardware.spec: Old GM bolt or harmonic balancer installer
hardware.torqueSequence: Draw balancer fully onto snout, then remove the old bolt.
hardware.notes: Summit lists 244 ft-lb; other sources 240 ft-lb.

hardware.torque: 89 ft-lb, loosen 1 full turn, 59 ft-lb, then +125°

hardware.spec: GM TTY balancer bolt with rotating washer
hardware.torque: 89 ft-lb, loosen 1 full turn, 59 ft-lb, then +200°

installNotes: Identify which bolt design you have before choosing the final angle.
Lock the flywheel - never hold the crank via the timing chain.
